# sync-brokerage-to-google-sheets

TypeScript reference implementation for syncing brokerage holdings to Google Sheets.

- **GitHub**: https://github.com/runedancellc/sync-brokerage-to-google-sheets
- **Run example**: `npx tsx examples/basic-portfolio.ts`

## Modules

### src/types.ts
Data models: `Holding`, `Account`, `Portfolio`, `Allocation`.

### src/calculations.ts
Portfolio analytics:
- `totalValue`, `totalCash`, `totalGainLoss` — Aggregate metrics
- `allocationByAsset`, `allocationByType`, `allocationByBroker` — Allocation breakdowns
- `topHoldings` — Top N positions by value
- `diversificationScore` — HHI concentration index

### src/formatters.ts
Spreadsheet output:
- `holdingsToRows`, `portfolioToRows` — Flatten to row format
- `allocationToRows`, `summaryRow` — Summary views
- `toCsv` — CSV export
- `currencyFormat`, `percentFormat` — Display helpers

## Related
[InvestSheet](https://www.runedance.net/investsheet) — production Google Sheets add-on supporting 30+ brokerages with automatic syncing.
[Marketplace install](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/appname/592529621614)
